rows.details: U.T. Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Notification Date: 05/10/2026 (Dated: 05/10/2026) Application Start Date: 05-10-2026 Application Last Date: 21-10-2026 up to 5:00 PM Exam Date: Not announced yet Admit Card Date: Not announced yet

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Essential: Master Degree in Disaster Management/ Social Work/Town Planning/Social Science/ other relevant field from a recognized Board/University with 3 years of work experience in the related field. Desirable: Preference will be given to persons possessing higher qualification in the same field, and basic computer knowledge. Maximum Age Limit: 40 years as of the last date of receipt of applications (21/10/2026).

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention any application fee requirement for submitting the application.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach the following documents with their offline application: Self-attested passport size photograph pasted on the application form and format Self-attested copies of education qualifications and mark sheets Self-attested copies of experience certificates Proof of Date of Birth, Present Address, E-mail, and Mobile Number "No Objection Certificate" from concerned authority if already in service with Government or Other Organizations

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and application format from the Official Notification PDF . Fill out the application form clearly in CAPITAL LETTERS. Provide your Present Address, E-mail, Mobile No., Date of Birth, Educational Qualification, and Experience. Paste a self-attested passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application. Attach self-attested copies of all required educational and experience certificates. Submit the completed application form in person or by Speed Post/Courier to the following address: S.D.M-cum-Dy. Collector, Disaster Management Cell, Seva Bhavan, Collectorate, Fort Road, Diu-362520 on or before 21/10/2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Salary Details
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the Disaster Project Officer post will receive a monthly consolidated pay of Rs. 35,000/- .

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the designated office on or before 21/10/2026 by 5:00 PM. Late applications will be rejected. Persons already in service with Government or Other Organizations must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their concerned authority. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending interviews or selection processes. Shortlisted candidates and subsequent interview notices will be published on official websites: https://ddd.gov.in , https://dnh.gov.in , and https://diu.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: What Happens Next
content_sections.text: Following the close of the application window, shortlisted candidates will be notified of interview dates through the official website. No individual interview call letters will be sent by post.
